*It starts moving a heartbeat before the strike, following a future the attacker has not yet reached.*

Before one attack from a visible attacker against this creature is rolled, impose 1 Bane on that attack. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to its single defense roll instead. This changes no target or outcome after dice have been rolled; it does not cancel the action.

details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Verdict of stone

**Target:** One visible creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Dazed 2. **Standard defense:** Dazed 1.

### Seen It Already

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Study a challenger before delivering a verdict. A party that listens to the warning may achieve more than one that wins an exchange of blows.

**Encounter and conversation:** It tests whether visitors understand a warning, not whether they can guess a clever password.

**Habitat:** Wild frontier; ancient ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-sphinx


**Category:** Beast · **Role:** Disabler · **CV:** 40

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verdict of stone | Reason | 1 Boon | 3 mental damage. | 6 mental damage. Dazed 1. | 9 mental damage. Dazed 2. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/9

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.55

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.55: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.404, O=6.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [Seen It Already](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seen-it-already.md), [stunning strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/stunning-strike.md), [watch the opening](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/watch-the-opening.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
